Input image 1 is the existing holographic software-architecture scene to correct.
Input image 2 is the original reference for the man's exact face, glasses, swept dark hair and polished 3D cartoon style.
Make a corrected version of image 1 with TWO ESSENTIAL GEOMETRY FIXES:
1. The worktable is ONE structurally coherent, unbroken object: a single continuous solid dark-graphite rectangular tabletop with a gently rounded perimeter, one straight uninterrupted front edge, uniform thickness, and four clean metal legs consistently attached at its corners. The tabletop must be OPAQUE and visibly solid from edge to edge. Cyan interface lines sit ON the solid top; no transparency holes, fractures, separated slabs, glitches, gaps, intersecting planes or duplicated edges. Render it as a physically plausible premium engineering desk.
2. The man stands entirely BESIDE the LEFT SHORT END of the table, not behind its middle and never inside it. His ENTIRE body silhouette, both hips, both dark-blue jeans legs and BOTH black shoes must be visible to the LEFT of the tabletop and table legs, with a clear visible air gap between his torso/hips/legs and the left edge of the table. The table starts to the RIGHT of his hips and occupies the right half of the composition. Do not let the table cover or pass through his torso, waist, jeans or shoes.
Keep the same identifiable young man, same face, glasses, hairstyle and friendly attentive expression. Outfit exactly: plain fitted BLACK short-sleeved T-shirt, DARK INDIGO denim jeans (deep navy, not medium-blue), ALL-BLACK minimalist sneakers.
Above the tabletop, a few tidy blue-cyan holographic SOFTWARE SYSTEM nodes, connected by clear fine arrows: Client -> API Gateway -> two services -> Database, with a small cloud node. Holograms stay entirely above the table's right-hand area, not across the man's body.
